candidate4_fact.value: All coffee has a long journey to reach us here in Wisconsin, but Muungano rivals for the longest and most difficult pathway. Coopérative Agricole Muungano is located on the shores of Lake Kivu in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The cooperative has many challenges to overcome to produce exceptional coffee, but a lot of hard work and perseverance pay off in the cup. “Muungano” means “Togetherness” in Swahili. In a region of the world that is no stranger to social unrest and where there are infrastructure challenges every step of the way, the concept of togetherness is a hopeful message to share. This coffee is from Muungano’s resilient women producer group within the cooperative. From the heart of Africa to North Avenue, many hands work together to cultivate and share this beautiful coffee with the world.

candidate4_fact.label: Product summary
candidate4_fact.value: OLMAN SAUCEDA NUEVA SEGOVIA, NICARAGUA Malt, Honeydew Melon, Lime Zest Since 2018, we’ve proudly sourced exceptional coffees from our friend Olman Sauceda. Elite Honey is one of the first two we’re releasing from his farm, Finca Elite, this season. Elite Honey is a honey-processed Pacamara, a variety known for its larger bean size, creamy mouthfeel, and natural sweetness. The honey process — drying the bean with its mucilage intact — builds on those qualities with added body and a subtle fruit character, presenting rich, sweet malt, a soft honeydew melon, and a bright flourish of lime zest. Finca Elite is a family-run farm known for adapting unique varieties like Chiroso, Orange Geisha, Sidra, and Pink Bourbon to Nicaragua’s climate — work that earned them First Place in the 2025 Nicaragua Cup of Excellence.
